core_obligations: Explain the parenthetical and prove (1) by pushing forward and reducing to quasi-coherence of the internal Hom of the pseudo-coherent module O_Z (proof lines 2392-2412).
Prove (2) by representing K algebraically, passing to injectives on both sides, constructing the comparison map and checking it is an isomorphism after pushing forward (proof lines 2414-2446).
proof_roadmap: The affine comparison: representation and construction (proof lines 2414-2436).
difficulty_reason: For a pseudo-coherent closed immersion i : Z -> X (any closed immersion if X is locally Noetherian) the lemma asserts that RSheafHom(O_Z, -) maps D^+_QCoh(O_X) into D^+_QCoh(O_Z), and that when X = Spec(A) and Z = Spec(B) the square relating D^+(B) -> D^+_QCoh(O_Z) with RHom(B, -) to D^+(A) -> D^+_QCoh(O_X) with RSheafHom(O_Z, -) commutes (statement lines 2372-2390). The parenthetical is explained by More on Morphisms, Lemma labelled more-morphisms-lemma-Noetherian-pseudo-coherent (proof lines 2392-2396). For (1), by Morphisms, Lemma labelled morphisms-lemma-i-star-equivalence it suffices to show that i_* applied to each H^n(RSheafHom(O_Z, K)) is quasi-coherent on X, which by Lemma labelled lemma-sheaf-with-exact-support-ext means showing that RSheafHom_{O_X}(i_*O_Z, K) lies in D_QCoh(O_X); since i is pseudo-coherent the sheaf O_Z is a pseudo-coherent O_X-module, so Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma labelled perfect-lemma-quasi-coherence-internal-hom applies (proof lines 2398-2412). For (2) the proof represents a complex K by a bounded below complex I^bullet of injective A-modules, so that RHom(B, K) = Hom_A(B, I^bullet), chooses a quasi-isomorphism from its tilde to a bounded below complex of injective O_X-modules with the description of SheafHom(O_Z, -) from Lemma labelled lemma-compute-sheaf-with-exact-support, and produces a map tilde{Hom_A(B, I^bullet)} -> RSheafHom(O_Z, tilde{K}) in D(O_Z), which is checked to be an isomorphism after applying i_*, where it becomes the isomorphism of Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma labelled perfect-lemma-quasi-coherence-internal-hom through the identification of the exact support lemma (proof lines 2414-2446). Reducing quasi-coherence to the internal Hom of a pseudo-coherent module, and verifying the affine comparison after pushing forward, is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
